svg.text: Animation and visual structure only — colour and type are supplied separately.
drag into Figma · every layer editable
four curves — nothing else is permitted
every entrance. fast start, long settle.
ease · ease-in-out · ease-in · any spring that overshoots past 1.02 — browser defaults read as unstyled, overshoot reads as consumer-toy
pick from the ladder — never an arbitrary number
colour and opacity on small UI
hover states, underline sweep, nav item
card and media reveal, image scale
offset between siblings in a reveal
≤ 3 words. char stagger on a full sentence is the loudest slop signal
cards, list rows, spec table lines
every section uses one of these eight
900ms reveal · 90ms stagger · fires once at 85% viewport · never re-runs on scroll-back
1400ms curtain on the wipe, drift on the scale. parent keeps overflow:hidden.
native position:sticky. preload the whole sequence behind a numeric counter.
layers at different speeds, one running counter-direction. bound the travel so a track never exposes empty space.
never exceed 1.25× — past that it induces motion sickness and reads cheap.
use this instead of a three-up card grid. the pinned visual responds to section progress.
ring position lerps at 0.14, dot is exact. fine-pointer only — gate behind (hover:hover).
panel wipes up · route swaps behind · exits up
1400ms curtain. the outgoing page holds still — never animate both at once.
static structure the motion sits on
content at cols 1–5 or 7–12. centre only for the hero.
mega type and media exceed the container and clip at the viewport edge.
wordmark · nav · micro-label triplet · live scroll % · rotated side tab
cheap to build, and the fastest signal a human art-directed the page.
product cutouts overlap the headline — above the type, below the nav.
nothing else does as much for perceived quality.
transform · opacity · clip-path · filter. never width, height, top, left, or margin.
maximum per element. more than that and the intent stops reading.
all scroll-linked work through a single rAF, lerp 0.12. pin with native position:sticky.
measure line breaks only once document.fonts.ready resolves, or masks won't match the wrap.
every scrubbed sequence resolves to its finished state — never left invisible, never jump-cut.
lock every media aspect-ratio before load. CLS under 0.05.
